description: Invoice Matching exercise: the buyer's purchase orders, as SAP would hold them. One row per order the course generator issued. Look an order up by POID = the PO number on the invoice. Participants' processes read it; the generator writes it.

fields.Name: POID
fields.Description: The purchase order number, PO-<8 digits>, unique: the key to look up by (the invoice's poNumber, the extraction's out_PONumber). Query results spell the field Poid.

fields.Name: PODATA
fields.Description: The purchase order as JSON text: {poNumber, poDate, currency, vendor {name, address, country, taxId, contact, phone}, buyer {same}, lines [{n, description, quantity, unitPrice, lineTotal, deliveryDate, material}], subtotal, taxName, taxRate, taxTotal, total}: the invoice shape plus poDate, contacts, per-line delivery date and material.

fields.Name: POHTML
fields.Description: The order rendered as the buyer's SAP display screen (HTML file). The Invoice Validation app shows it to the reviewer; not for parsing, use PODATA.
